arguments.sql:
SELECT d.A3 AS region,
       QUOTE(t.k_symbol) AS stored_characterization,
       TYPEOF(t.k_symbol) AS characterization_type,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       MIN(t.date) AS earliest_date,
       MAX(t.date) AS latest_date,
       MIN(LENGTH(t.date)) AS min_date_length,
       MAX(LENGTH(t.date)) AS max_date_length
FROM main.district AS d
JOIN main.account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN main.trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
GROUP BY d.A3, t.k_symbol
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

arguments.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS branch_name,
       COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM main.district AS d
LEFT JOIN main.account AS a
       ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN main.trans AS t
       ON t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
      AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3
